content.user_title: Build Responsive Email HTML and Render QA
content.value_statement: Email HTML often breaks across clients, dark mode, and image blocking. This skill builds responsive email markup and produces a structured render QA report.
actual_capabilities: Converts approved email creative into a single-column, table-based HTML layout with inline styles.
Applies responsive layout patterns for Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, iOS Mail, and Android.
Reviews dark-mode contrast, accessibility, image-off fallbacks, and bulletproof calls to action.
Produces a client render matrix labeled Measured or Estimated.
Creates or compares a plain-text alternate for message and link parity.
Reports render defects without changing approved copy.
limitations: It does not write or revise subject lines, body copy, or call-to-action text.
Estimated compatibility results do not replace real seed-list or inbox-preview testing.
Live render tests require an available email platform connector and user-owned test inboxes.
It does not score email quality or calculate SEND metrics.

use_cases.title: Build a promotional email
use_cases.description: Convert approved campaign creative into responsive HTML with dark-mode, accessibility, and image-off safeguards.

use_cases.title: Repair client rendering defects
use_cases.description: Diagnose and fix Outlook, Gmail, Apple Mail, or mobile layout problems without changing approved copy.

use_cases.title: Prepare a review handoff
use_cases.description: Produce a labeled client matrix, plain-text parity check, and defect report before quality scoring.

prompt_templates.title: Build from approved creative
prompt_templates.prompt: Build responsive email HTML from this approved subject, preheader, body, CTA, and destination: [content]. Use the standard client set.

prompt_templates.title: Run client QA
prompt_templates.prompt: QA this email HTML for Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, iOS Mail, and Android. Report dark-mode, image-off, accessibility, and responsiveness defects: [HTML].

prompt_templates.title: Repair confirmed defects
prompt_templates.prompt: Fix the confirmed rendering defects in this approved HTML without changing copy: [HTML]. Preserve brand colors and document every compatibility tradeoff.

prompt_templates.title: Compare implementation strategies
prompt_templates.prompt: Create two render-safe implementations for this approved creative: [content]. Compare fluid-hybrid and media-query approaches, then recommend one for these clients: [clients].

output_examples.input: Build a promotional email for Gmail and Outlook from approved creative.
output: Responsive single-column build using inline styles and a fluid-hybrid layout.
Dark-mode and accessibility checklist with explicit pass or fail results.
Estimated client matrix plus a matching plain-text alternate.

output_examples.input: QA an existing newsletter that breaks in Outlook and with images disabled.
output: Defect report identifying unsupported layout styles and image-only content.
Revised build with Outlook-safe structure, bulletproof buttons, and text fallbacks.
Compatibility matrix that separates measured evidence from estimated behavior.

best_practices: Provide approved creative, destination links, brand constraints, target clients, and any real render evidence.
Use seed-list or inbox-preview results to upgrade estimated client rows to measured results.
Review every reported copy-related defect separately because the skill preserves approved wording.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to invent campaign copy when no approved creative exists.
Do not treat estimated client support as proof of a successful real-world render.
Do not place offers, claims, or calls to action only inside images.

faq.question: Can this skill write the email copy?
faq.answer: No. It expects approved creative and reports copy changes that another writing workflow must handle.

faq.question: Which email clients does it cover?
faq.answer: The default set includes Gmail, Outlook desktop and web, Apple Mail, iOS Mail, and Android clients.

faq.question: Does it perform real inbox rendering?
faq.answer: Only when real seed-list, inbox-preview, or connector results are available. Otherwise, client outcomes remain Estimated.

faq.question: Can it fix dark-mode issues?
faq.answer: Yes. It reviews explicit colors, contrast, forced inversion risks, and logo visibility across light and dark modes.

faq.question: Does it include accessibility checks?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks reading order, image alternatives, language metadata, contrast, mobile font sizing, and descriptive links.

faq.question: Will it create a plain-text version?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create or compare a plain-text alternate and verify that messages, calls to action, and links match.
